comment.body: Thanks for confirming that the key appears on the Surface and that the hosts entries are present. That still leaves the first failure unknown: Settings/MWB IPC may reject a peer, or pairing may fail later during transport. Please reproduce one failed Connect attempt on both PCs and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward; also say whether MWB runs as service or user on each and quote the first pairing error. This will distinguish the known #50795 signer issue from a separate connection failure.
